InstitutionFacility

Functions

initialize_reflexive

Fill the reflection lists of a dataclass (class decorator).
initialize_reflexive(cls)[source]

Fill the reflection lists of a dataclass (class decorator).

Parameters:
clstype

Dataclass to decorate; it must already be a dataclass.

Returns:
type

The same class, with PROPERTIES and DATA_PROPERTIES set.

Notes

PROPERTIES receives the names of the dataclass fields, in declaration order (ClassVar names are not fields). DATA_PROPERTIES receives the default value of each init field; a field without a default contributes dataclasses.MISSING.
